quests.instruction: Arrange the words to ask about language exchange.
quests.correctAnswer: Could you recommend a good language exchange partner programme ?
quests.hint: Start with 'Could you recommend a good'.
quests.explanation: Language exchange programmes pair people who want to practise each other's language.

quests.instruction: Order the words about exam preparation.
quests.correctAnswer: I have been preparing for this language exam for six months .
quests.hint: Start with 'I have been preparing for'.
quests.explanation: Present perfect continuous with 'for' shows how long a preparation has been ongoing.

quests.instruction: Put the words in order to ask for a language learning strategy.
quests.correctAnswer: What is the most effective way to remember new vocabulary ?
quests.hint: Start with 'What is the most effective way'.
quests.explanation: This question seeks advice on remembering words more efficiently.

quests.instruction: Arrange the words about a language learning strategy.
quests.correctAnswer: Reading in a foreign language every day improves comprehension dramatically .
quests.hint: Start with 'Reading in a foreign language'.
quests.explanation: A gerund subject introduces a proven language learning tip.

quests.instruction: Order the words about a vocabulary building strategy.
quests.correctAnswer: I have found keeping a vocabulary notebook really useful .
quests.hint: Start with 'I have found keeping'.
quests.explanation: 'Found + gerund + adjective' expresses a personal discovery.

quests.instruction: Put the words in order about language learning through films.
quests.correctAnswer: Watching films in the target language also helps with pronunciation .
quests.hint: Start with 'Watching films in the target language'.
quests.explanation: A gerund subject introduces a useful language learning tip.

quests.instruction: Arrange the words about a class assignment.
quests.correctAnswer: The professor asked us to prepare a ten-minute presentation .
quests.hint: Start with 'The professor asked us to prepare'.
quests.explanation: Simple past reports an instruction that has already been given.

quests.instruction: Order the words about a group project experience.
quests.correctAnswer: I was partnered with someone whose first language was Korean .
quests.hint: Start with 'I was partnered with someone whose'.
quests.explanation: Passive voice 'was partnered' means someone else decided the arrangement.

quests.instruction: Put the words in order about group work organisation.
quests.correctAnswer: We divided the research so each person contributed equally .
quests.hint: Start with 'We divided the research so'.
quests.explanation: 'So + clause' explains the purpose or result of an action.

quests.instruction: Arrange the words to ask about someone's study abroad decision.
quests.correctAnswer: What made you decide to study in this particular city ?
quests.hint: Start with 'What made you decide to study'.
quests.explanation: 'What made you + verb?' asks about the reason behind a past decision.

quests.instruction: Order the words to give a reason for a study choice.
quests.correctAnswer: I chose it mainly because of the quality of the university .
quests.hint: Start with 'I chose it mainly because of'.
quests.explanation: 'Mainly because of' introduces the primary reason for a decision.

quests.instruction: Put the words in order about the benefits of studying abroad.
quests.correctAnswer: The multicultural environment here has really broadened my perspective .
quests.hint: Start with 'The multicultural environment here has'.
quests.explanation: 'Broadened my perspective' means it expanded your understanding of the world.

quests.instruction: Arrange the words about a language learning challenge.
quests.correctAnswer: I find it hard to follow conversations when people speak fast .
quests.hint: Start with 'I find it hard to follow conversations'.
quests.explanation: 'Find it + adjective + to + verb' expresses difficulty doing something.

quests.instruction: Order the words to ask someone to speak more slowly.
quests.correctAnswer: Could you slow down a bit so I can understand better ?
quests.hint: Start with 'Could you slow down a bit so'.
quests.explanation: 'So I can' introduces the reason or purpose behind the request.

quests.instruction: Put the words in order to reassure someone about a language challenge.
quests.correctAnswer: Do not worry it comes with practice and regular exposure over time .
quests.hint: Start with 'Do not worry it comes with practice'.
quests.explanation: Use this encouraging phrase to motivate someone who is struggling.

quests.instruction: Arrange the words about a career appointment.
quests.correctAnswer: She has recently been appointed as head of the legal department .
quests.hint: Start with 'She has recently been appointed as'.
quests.explanation: Present perfect passive 'has been appointed' with 'recently' reports a new development.

quests.instruction: Order the words to congratulate someone on a new role.
quests.correctAnswer: Congratulations on taking on such a significant new responsibility .
quests.hint: Start with 'Congratulations on taking on'.
quests.explanation: 'On taking on' uses a gerund after 'on' to explain the achievement.

quests.instruction: Put the words in order to wish someone well in their new role.
quests.correctAnswer: I hope you settle in quickly and enjoy the new challenge .
quests.hint: Start with 'I hope you settle in quickly'.
quests.explanation: 'Hope + subject + verb' expresses a sincere wish on someone's behalf.

quests.instruction: Arrange the words for a transport announcement.
quests.correctAnswer: We have been experiencing some disruption on the Northern line today .
quests.hint: Start with 'We have been experiencing some disruption'.
quests.explanation: Present perfect continuous is used for ongoing situations affecting customers.

quests.instruction: Order the words for a formal public transport announcement.
quests.correctAnswer: Passengers are advised to use alternative routes where possible .
quests.hint: Start with 'Passengers are advised to'.
quests.explanation: Passive voice 'are advised to' is formal and impersonal in announcements.

quests.instruction: Put the words in order for a formal public apology.
quests.correctAnswer: We apologise for any inconvenience caused by this disruption .
quests.hint: Start with 'We apologise for any inconvenience caused'.
quests.explanation: This formal phrase is used in official communications to express regret.

quests.instruction: Arrange the words to express surprise about a meeting's length.
quests.correctAnswer: I was not expecting the meeting to take quite so long .
quests.hint: Start with 'I was not expecting the meeting to take'.
quests.explanation: Past continuous 'was not expecting' shows that something was unexpected.

quests.instruction: Order the words to comment on a meeting.
quests.correctAnswer: The discussion went off topic several times which was frustrating .
quests.hint: Start with 'The discussion went off topic'.
quests.explanation: 'Went off topic' means the discussion moved away from the main subject.

quests.instruction: Put the words in order to suggest meeting improvement.
quests.correctAnswer: Perhaps we should set a clearer agenda before the next meeting .
quests.hint: Start with 'Perhaps we should set a clearer agenda'.
quests.explanation: 'Perhaps' softens a suggestion, making it less direct and more collaborative.

quests.instruction: Arrange the words to express heartfelt gratitude.
quests.correctAnswer: I really appreciate you taking the time to explain this to me .
quests.hint: Start with 'I really appreciate you taking the time'.
quests.explanation: 'Appreciate + gerund' is a warm and formal way to express thanks.

quests.instruction: Order the words to offer ongoing support.
quests.correctAnswer: Do not hesitate to reach out if you need any further help .
quests.hint: Start with 'Do not hesitate to reach out'.
quests.explanation: This phrase is a polite invitation for someone to ask for help in future.

quests.instruction: Put the words in order to close a business relationship warmly.
quests.correctAnswer: It has been a real pleasure working with your team this year .
quests.hint: Start with 'It has been a real pleasure working'.
quests.explanation: 'It has been a pleasure + gerund' is a professional closing phrase.

quests.instruction: Arrange the words for a reflective interview question.
quests.correctAnswer: What do you think is the most rewarding aspect of your work ?
quests.hint: Start with 'What do you think is the most rewarding'.
quests.explanation: After 'What do you think', use statement word order in the embedded clause.

quests.instruction: Order the words to describe what gives you meaning at work.
quests.correctAnswer: I find real satisfaction in helping people solve difficult problems .
quests.hint: Start with 'I find real satisfaction in helping'.
quests.explanation: 'Find satisfaction in + gerund' expresses what gives you fulfilment.

quests.instruction: Put the words in order to express work motivation.
quests.correctAnswer: Knowing your work makes a real difference motivates you to continue .
quests.hint: Start with 'Knowing your work makes a real difference'.
quests.explanation: A gerund clause as subject expresses a motivating principle.
